simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲדֻלָּם (H5725) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֲדֻלָּם (ʻĂdullâm) means Adullam , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 15.

definitions.full: H5725. Adullam עֲדֻלָּם proper name, of a location old Canaanite city , ᵐ5 Οδολλαμ , with king Josh 12:15 (D), in the שְׁפֵלָה 15:35 (P; ᵐ5 L Αδαλαμ ), compare Micah 1:15 ; Neh 11:30 ; (re-)built by Rehod. according to 2Chr 11:17 ( Οδολαμ ); ׳ע מְעָרַת (read מְצָדַת מְצֻדַת, , see מְעָרָה below I. ערר ) 1Sam 22:1 ; 2Sam 23:13 ; 1Chr 11:15 ; site probably I`d-el-Mîye ( `Aid el-Ma ), approximately 13 miles west-southwest from Bethlehem, see GASm Geogr.229 Buhl Geogr.193 and references .
definitions.rootNote: probably from the passive participle of the same as 5724 ;
